description: Report something wrong with a result: wrong data, a filter that did not filter, a ranking that put off-topic results first, a number you could not reproduce, or an answer that was useless for your task. Free, and the fastest way to get a defect fixed — this is read by a human. Say what you expected as well as what you got.

about.description: Optional slug, aid or tag the report concerns.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

problem.description: What was wrong. Be specific — the tool you called, the arguments, and what came back.

severity.description: wrong = factually incorrect; misleading = correct but reads as something else; unhelpful = right and useless.

tool.description: Optional name of the tool that produced it.

name: submit_feedback
